name: ci-security
summary: Supply-chain checks for a project on GitHub: workflow lint (actionlint, zizmor), Dependency Review, pnpm audit, OpenSSF Scorecard, a Dockerfile check, a security policy, Renovate or Dependabot, and a command that names the repository settings that are off.

options.renovate: Renovate opens the update pull requests and the security fixes. A person installs its GitHub App on the repository first.
options.dependabot: Dependabot opens them instead. Nothing to install, but under the starter's Node it updates the actions only.
